name: AXM Game Production Runner
actions: run an explicit game fixture candidate
run an explicit portable-profile fixture candidate
run an explicit content-verified documentation candidate
emit a sealed checkpoint at graceful interruption
reuse an explicit external verified artifact cache
invalidate one exact cache entry explicitly
discover cache references from sealed terminal or checkpoint ledgers read-only
apply one exact approved cache retention proposal
probe trusted Hand confinement substrate explicitly
summary: Compile locked intent into exact production packages and run bounded game or portable-profile candidate work with independent evidence and no automatic installation.
notes: v0.1 executes inert fixtures plus one trusted in-process deterministic documentation Hand. Graceful interruption appends a sealed checkpoint bound to the exact step-ledger count, tail, verified receipt prefix, and prior checkpoint. An opt-in external cache reuses only executors declaring deterministic-v1, verifies immutable entry bytes, and reruns the current appointed verifier on every hit. Bounded read-only discovery derives path-private reference sets from fully validated terminal receipts or the latest exact checkpoint chain. Uncheckpointed progress, stale/tampered checkpoints, and invalid terminal receipts hold. Retention freshly rescans references and cache state before an explicitly approved deletion with readback. No lease, schedule, or automatic deletion exists. Native Godot production remains separately gated and unclaimed.
